title: Scott McLaughlin ends drought in Monterey; Alex Palou revels in 5th title
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Scott McLaughlin ended his 2026 IndyCar season with a long-sought victory at the Mission Foods Grand Prix of Monterey before Alex Palou lifted the trophy for the series championship Sunday in Monterey, Calif.

title: Quiet finish to Dixon’s epic Ganassi tenure
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: The last race of Scott Dixon’s farewell season with Chip Ganassi Racing ended in a similar fashion to the first race of 2026. Both were unrewarding and unrepresentative of the six-time champion’s 25-year tenure with CGR, but he persevered through adversity to place 17th in the No. 9 Honda and farewell the only team he’s known since 2002.

title: IndyCar legends unite to launch Zanardi Corkscrew era at Laguna Seca
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Thirty years ago at Turn 8, which is better known as the Corkscrew – named for its curling and winding pathway that plunges down the hill – Alex Zanardi executed “The Pass” on Bryan Herta to earn the win at the 1996 CART IndyCar Series season finale. On its 30th anniversary, the renowned corner was renamed in the Italian’s honor with IndyCar luminaries on hand and on track.

title: Conor Daly lands full-time IndyCar ride with D&R
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Conor Daly has been named the full-time driver for Dreyer & Reinbold Racing's new IndyCar Series entry in 2027. Daly, 34, will drive the No. 24 Honda for the Indianapolis-based team that he first raced for at the 2024 Indianapolis 500, where he finished 10th.
